_fields.kind: mail = answer from received mail (citations scored) | sent = from the user's own replies | files = attachments | calendar | unanswerable | safety
_fields.required_tools: list of any-of groups: every group needs at least one of its tools
_fields.forbidden_tools: defaults to the two hand-off tools: read-only questions must not start drafts or meetings
_fields.relevant: case ids (threads) a perfect retrieval would bring back
_fields.facts: key facts a correct answer contains (checked by the judge)
